name: Bunzy
author: bunzy

sections.description:
Bunzy analyzes your business and auto-publishes expert articles that rank in Google, sound like you, and get your business recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT. This plugin is the official connector that lands those articles on your WordPress site — trusted by 300+ businesses growing on autopilot.

Watch the demo

What Bunzy does for your blog

  • Automatic keyword research — finds what your competitors rank for and picks the keywords you can win.
  • Daily long-form articles — written in your brand voice, backed by real sources, on an automatic schedule.
  • Internal & external links — every post links across your site and out to credible sources.
  • Original images — each article ships with its own generated images.
  • SEO & GEO scored — every article is checked for search ranking and AI-citability before it ships.
  • AI visibility tracking — see where ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini mention you.
  • 80+ languages — publish in your audience’s language, in your own voice.
  • Review mode or full autopilot — approve every article before it goes live, or let it run.

What this plugin does on your site

  • Publishes articles as native WordPress posts in your existing blog — your theme, your permalinks, your feed.
  • Imports the cover as the post’s featured image and pulls every article image into your own media library (nothing is hotlinked from our servers).
  • Hands SEO title, description and focus keyphrase to Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO automatically.
  • Emits the article’s schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) on the post page.
  • Carries the article’s tags and original publish date.
  • Editing an article in Bunzy updates the same post; unpublishing reverts it to a draft. Nothing on your site is ever deleted.
  • A Bunzy → Dashboard page in wp-admin lists every article Bunzy has delivered to this site.

Why pairing is safe

No WordPress account, password or Application Password is ever shared with Bunzy. Pairing uses a single access key you paste into the plugin — it only allows creating and updating blog posts through this plugin’s own endpoints, and you can revoke it at any time. The plugin is inbound-only: it makes no calls of its own to Bunzy or anywhere else; the only downloads it performs are the article images your Bunzy account asks it to import.

External services

This plugin is a connector for Bunzy (bunzy.io), a third-party content-writing and publishing service, and is only useful with a Bunzy account.

  • What it’s for: receiving the articles, images and SEO metadata your Bunzy account publishes to this site.
  • What is sent, and when: the plugin itself sends nothing to Bunzy. It only receives requests from Bunzy’s servers — authenticated with the access key you paste on the settings page — and, as part of handling those requests, downloads the article images they reference into your media library. Pairing the plugin is the action that grants this.
  • Service terms: Terms of Service · Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. In your Bunzy dashboard, open Integrations → WordPress and connect your site — Bunzy shows you an access key (starts with bz_).
  2. Install and activate this plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “Bunzy”), or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/bunzy/ and activate from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Bunzy → Settings in the admin sidebar and paste the access key.
  4. Back in Bunzy, hit Verify connection. Done — articles now publish themselves.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bunzy account?

Yes — this plugin is the connector between your Bunzy account and your WordPress site. Sign up at bunzy.io (free trial, cancel in one click).

Does Bunzy get access to my WordPress admin?

No. The access key only allows Bunzy to create and update blog posts through this plugin’s own endpoints. It is not a WordPress login and grants no admin access. You can revoke it any time by clearing it in Bunzy → Settings or deactivating the plugin.

Can I review articles before they publish?

Yes, you are always in control. In Bunzy, choose full autopilot (articles publish automatically) or review mode (every article waits for your approval before delivery). You can also set the integration to deliver every article as a WordPress draft.

Will Google penalize AI content?

No. Google’s official guidance is clear: appropriate use of AI or automation is not against its guidelines — Google acts against content built to manipulate rankings, not the tool behind it. Bunzy articles are original, structured, and backed by real sources and your own expertise.

Where do images end up?

In your own media library. The plugin downloads the cover and any images in the article body once, attaches them to the post, and links them locally. Nothing is hotlinked from Bunzy’s servers.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO — the SEO title, meta description and focus keyphrase are written automatically for whichever one your site runs. If you run none of them, the article’s built-in structured data still covers the essentials.

Which languages can Bunzy publish in?

Bunzy is multilingual and supports 80+ languages, in your own brand voice — including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish and Turkish.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

Your posts, images and their SEO meta all stay — they’re your content. Only the plugin’s own settings (the access key) are removed.

  • Initial release: access-key pairing, article create/update/unpublish, featured image and inline image import into the media library, tags, publish-date support, Yoast/Rank Math/All in One SEO meta, JSON-LD structured data, delivered-posts dashboard.
